name: svg-french-press-muse-wonder-s3-r2
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1100" height="1360" viewBox="0 0 1100 1360">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="steel" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#e8ecf0"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#b9c2cc"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#8e9aa6"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="steelSide" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#cbd3db"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#7f8b97"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="glass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#d9eef3" stop-opacity="0.55"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#eef8fa" stop-opacity="0.25"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#c4dfe8" stop-opacity="0.55"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="black" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#4a4a4d"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#17181a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <pattern id="mesh" width="9" height="9" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="rotate(45)">
      <rect width="9" height="9" fill="#d7dde2"/>
      <path d="M0 0H9 M0 4.5H9 M0 0V9 M4.5 0V9" stroke="#707c86" stroke-width="0.8"/>
    </pattern>
    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="4" refY="4" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0 0 L8 4 L0 8 z" fill="#8a8f98"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <rect width="1100" height="1360" fill="#f7f5f0"/>
  <!-- header -->
  <text x="55" y="62" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="42" font-weight="700" fill="#22252a">French Press</text>
  <text x="57" y="96" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="17" letter-spacing="2.5" fill="#6d727b">EXPLODED ASSEMBLY DIAGRAM</text>
  <line x1="55" y1="112" x2="1045" y2="112" stroke="#c9c3b8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="1045" y="96" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" letter-spacing="1" fill="#8a8578">SCALE: NOT TO SCALE</text>

  <!-- centre axis -->
  <line x1="400" y1="128" x2="400" y2="1245" stroke="#a8adb5" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-dasharray="14 7 3 7"/>

  <!-- assembly direction arrows on far left of axis -->
  <g stroke="#9aa0a8" stroke-width="1.6" marker-end="url(#arrow)">
    <line x1="225" y1="172" x2="225" y2="198"/>
    <line x1="225" y1="285" x2="225" y2="312"/>
    <line x1="225" y1="400" x2="225" y2="426"/>
    <line x1="225" y1="660" x2="225" y2="688"/>
    <line x1="225" y1="742" x2="225" y2="770"/>
  </g>
  <text x="205" y="152" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" letter-spacing="1.5" fill="#8a8f98" transform="rotate(-90 205 152)"></text>

  <!-- ============ 1 KNOB ============ -->
  <g>
    <!-- threaded stud below knob -->
    <rect x="394" y="172" width="12" height="22" fill="url(#steelSide)" stroke="#5f6973" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M394 178h12 M394 184h12 M394 190h12" stroke="#5f6973" stroke-width="0.8"/>
    <!-- knob ball -->
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="148" rx="34" ry="30" fill="url(#black)" stroke="#0e0f10" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="386" cy="136" rx="11" ry="7" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.35" transform="rotate(-25 386 136)"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="174" rx="18" ry="5" fill="#2b2c2e"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 2 LID ============ -->
  <g>
    <!-- skirt / underside rim -->
    <path d="M262 232 L262 252 A138 30 0 0 0 538 252 L538 232" fill="url(#steelSide)" stroke="#5f6973" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="252" rx="138" ry="30" fill="#8e9aa6" stroke="#5f6973" stroke-width="1"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="250" rx="124" ry="24" fill="#aeb9c3"/>
    <!-- raised dome top: tall arc so it reads as a dome, not a flat disc -->
    <path d="M262 232 A138 28 0 0 1 538 232 C 510 188, 462 172, 400 172 C 338 172, 290 188, 262 232 Z" fill="url(#steel)" stroke="#5f6973" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <path d="M300 206 C 330 184, 380 176, 430 180" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="6" opacity="0.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- centre hole boss on top of dome -->
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="176" rx="21" ry="7.5" fill="#7f8b97" stroke="#525c66" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="174" rx="9" ry="3.5" fill="#2f363d"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 3 PLUNGER ROD ============ -->
  <g>
    <rect x="394" y="298" width="12" height="118" fill="url(#steel)" stroke="#5f6973" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="396.5" y="300" width="3" height="112" fill="#fff" opacity="0.5"/>
    <!-- top thread (to knob, through lid) -->
    <path d="M394 306h12 M394 314h12 M394 322h12" stroke="#5f6973" stroke-width="0.9"/>
    <!-- bottom threaded end -->
    <rect x="393" y="410" width="14" height="26" fill="#aeb9c3" stroke="#5f6973" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M393 416h14 M393 422h14 M393 428h14" stroke="#5f6973" stroke-width="0.9"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 4 CROSS PLATE ============ -->
  <g>
    <path d="M272 478 L272 490 A128 27 0 0 0 528 490 L528 478" fill="url(#steelSide)" stroke="#525c66" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="478" rx="128" ry="27" fill="url(#steel)" stroke="#525c66" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <!-- pierced holes: two arcs of holes -->
    <g fill="#68737e" stroke="#4c565f" stroke-width="0.7">
      <ellipse cx="322" cy="472" rx="11" ry="4.5"/><ellipse cx="352" cy="464" rx="11" ry="4.5"/>
      <ellipse cx="448" cy="464" rx="11" ry="4.5"/><ellipse cx="478" cy="472" rx="11" ry="4.5"/>
      <ellipse cx="322" cy="488" rx="11" ry="4.5"/><ellipse cx="352" cy="494" rx="11" ry="4.5"/>
      <ellipse cx="448" cy="494" rx="11" ry="4.5"/><ellipse cx="478" cy="488" rx="11" ry="4.5"/>
    </g>
    <!-- cross arms hint: subtle X brace under the holes -->
    <path d="M306 466 L494 490 M494 466 L306 490" stroke="#8e9aa6" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.35"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="478" rx="17" ry="6.5" fill="#7f8b97" stroke="#4c565f"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="477" rx="7" ry="2.8" fill="#2f363d"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 5 MESH SCREEN ============ -->
  <g>
    <path d="M268 556 L268 564 A132 28 0 0 0 532 564 L532 556" fill="#9aa5b0" stroke="#525c66" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="556" rx="132" ry="28" fill="url(#mesh)" stroke="#44505a" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="556" rx="132" ry="28" fill="none" stroke="#2f363d" stroke-width="0.6" opacity="0.35"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="556" rx="16" ry="6" fill="#c7cfd6" stroke="#525c66"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="555" rx="7" ry="2.6" fill="#39424a"/>
    <text x="400" y="0" display="none">mesh</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 6 SPIRAL / SPRING PLATE ============ -->
  <g>
    <path d="M272 634 L272 644 A128 27 0 0 0 528 644 L528 634" fill="url(#steelSide)" stroke="#525c66" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="634" rx="128" ry="27" fill="url(#steel)" stroke="#525c66" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <!-- coiled spring edge: scalloped ring sitting on the rim -->
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="632" rx="130" ry="28" fill="none" stroke="#5c6771" stroke-width="6" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="634" rx="120" ry="24" fill="url(#steel)"/>
    <g fill="#7c8792" stroke="#4c565f" stroke-width="0.6">
      <ellipse cx="330" cy="628" rx="9" ry="3.6"/><ellipse cx="470" cy="628" rx="9" ry="3.6"/>
      <ellipse cx="330" cy="642" rx="9" ry="3.6"/><ellipse cx="470" cy="642" rx="9" ry="3.6"/>
      <ellipse cx="400" cy="620" rx="9" ry="3.6"/><ellipse cx="400" cy="649" rx="9" ry="3.6"/>
    </g>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="634" rx="17" ry="6.5" fill="#7f8b97" stroke="#4c565f"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="633" rx="7" ry="2.8" fill="#2f363d"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 7 BOTTOM SCREW ============ -->
  <g>
    <rect x="393" y="676" width="14" height="16" fill="#aeb9c3" stroke="#525c66"/>
    <path d="M393 681h14 M393 687h14" stroke="#525c66" stroke-width="0.8"/>
    <path d="M384 692 h32 l-4 14 a12 5 0 0 1 -24 0 z" fill="url(#steelSide)" stroke="#525c66" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="390" y1="699" x2="410" y2="699" stroke="#3c454e" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bracket grouping the 3-piece filter -->
  <g fill="none" stroke="#b07a3f" stroke-width="1.6">
    <path d="M565 452 h14 v208 h-14"/>
  </g>
  <text x="592" y="545" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12.5" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.6" fill="#9a6527">THREE-PIECE</text>
  <text x="592" y="563" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12.5" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.6" fill="#9a6527">FILTER ASSEMBLY</text>
  <text x="592" y="582" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#7d6a4d">mesh sandwiched</text>
  <text x="592" y="597" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#7d6a4d">between the two plates</text>

  <!-- ============ 8 GLASS BEAKER ============ -->
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <path d="M266 792 L274 1018 A126 26 0 0 0 526 1018 L534 792" fill="url(#glass)" stroke="#5f7f8c" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <!-- spout -->
    <path d="M266 792 L244 778 L252 800 L268 806 Z" fill="#d9eef3" stroke="#5f7f8c" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- top rim -->
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="792" rx="134" ry="27" fill="#eef8fa" fill-opacity="0.35" stroke="#5f7f8c" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="792" rx="120" ry="23" fill="#ffffff" fill-opacity="0.25" stroke="#88a5b0" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- base thickness -->
    <path d="M274 1006 A126 26 0 0 0 526 1006 L524 1020 A124 25 0 0 1 276 1020 Z" fill="#bcd9e2" opacity="0.7"/>
    <!-- highlight -->
    <path d="M292 820 L298 990" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="9" opacity="0.55" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- measure marks, kept well inside the glass -->
    <g stroke="#5f7f8c" stroke-width="1.4" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#4e6a75">
      <line x1="452" y1="862" x2="476" y2="862"/><text x="482" y="866" stroke="none">6</text>
      <line x1="456" y1="906" x2="478" y2="906"/><text x="484" y="910" stroke="none">4</text>
      <line x1="458" y1="950" x2="478" y2="950"/><text x="484" y="954" stroke="none">2</text>
    </g>
    <text x="452" y="842" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" letter-spacing="1" fill="#6d8a95">CUPS</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ 9 FRAME / HOLDER ============ -->
  <g>
    <!-- handle (behind) -->
    <path d="M532 1092 C 610 1085, 642 1120, 632 1162 C 625 1192, 590 1208, 540 1206" fill="none" stroke="#22252a" stroke-width="13" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M532 1092 C 610 1085, 642 1120, 632 1162 C 625 1192, 590 1208, 540 1206" fill="none" stroke="#4a4a4d" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
    <!-- vertical support struts joining collar to base -->
    <path d="M284 1096 L290 1206 L324 1206 L314 1098 Z" fill="url(#black)" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1"/>
    <path d="M486 1098 L476 1206 L510 1206 L516 1096 Z" fill="url(#black)" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- top collar band -->
    <path d="M262 1082 L262 1102 A138 29 0 0 0 538 1102 L538 1082" fill="url(#black)" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="1082" rx="138" ry="29" fill="#3a3b3e" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="1082" rx="124" ry="24" fill="#f7f5f0" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="1083" rx="124" ry="24" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="4" opacity="0.12"/>
    <!-- rivet on band -->
    <circle cx="532" cy="1094" r="5" fill="#c9ced4" stroke="#555"/>
    <!-- feet / base -->
    <path d="M268 1204 A132 27 0 0 0 532 1204 L524 1224 A124 24 0 0 1 276 1224 Z" fill="url(#black)" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="1204" rx="132" ry="27" fill="#2e2f32" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <ellipse cx="400" cy="1203" rx="112" ry="20" fill="#45464a"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ============ LABELS ============ -->
  <g font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
    <!-- helper style via groups -->
    <!-- 1 knob left -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="92" cy="142" r="13" fill="#22252a"/><text x="92" y="147" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#fff">1</text>
      <text x="112" y="138" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#22252a">Knob</text>
      <text x="112" y="157" font-size="11.5" fill="#71767e">screws onto rod</text>
      <path d="M205 146 H330" stroke="#9aa0a8" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/><circle cx="334" cy="146" r="3.5" fill="#22252a"/>
    </g>
    <!-- 2 lid right -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="708" cy="222" r="13" fill="#22252a"/><text x="708" y="227" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#fff">2</text>
      <text x="728" y="218" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#22252a">Lid</text>
      <text x="728" y="237" font-size="11.5" fill="#71767e">rod passes through centre hole</text>
      <path d="M540 226 H700" stroke="#9aa0a8" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/><circle cx="536" cy="226" r="3.5" fill="#22252a"/>
    </g>
    <!-- 3 rod right -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="708" cy="352" r="13" fill="#22252a"/><text x="708" y="357" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#fff">3</text>
      <text x="728" y="348" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#22252a">Plunger rod</text>
      <text x="728" y="367" font-size="11.5" fill="#71767e">threaded at both ends</text>
      <path d="M410 356 H700" stroke="#9aa0a8" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/><circle cx="406" cy="356" r="3.5" fill="#22252a"/>
    </g>
    <!-- 4 cross plate left -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="92" cy="472" r="13" fill="#b07a3f"/><text x="92" y="477" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#fff">4</text>
      <text x="112" y="468" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#22252a">Cross plate</text>
      <text x="112" y="487" font-size="11.5" fill="#71767e">top plate of the filter</text>
      <path d="M248 476 H282" stroke="#9aa0a8" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/><circle cx="286" cy="476" r="3.5" fill="#22252a"/>
      <path d="M112 492 L112 500 L250 500 L278 482" stroke="#9aa0a8" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0"/>
    </g>
    <!-- 5 mesh left -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="92" cy="550" r="13" fill="#b07a3f"/><text x="92" y="555" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#fff">5</text>
      <text x="112" y="546" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#22252a">Mesh screen</text>
      <text x="112" y="565" font-size="11.5" fill="#71767e">fine stainless filter mesh</text>
      <path d="M260 554 H282" stroke="#9aa0a8" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/><circle cx="286" cy="554" r="3.5" fill="#22252a"/>
      <path d="M215 558 L262 556" stroke="#9aa0a8" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    </g>
    <!-- need leader lines from text to part for left labels 4/5: draw longer -->
    <!-- 6 spiral plate left -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="92" cy="628" r="13" fill="#b07a3f"/><text x="92" y="633" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#fff">6</text>
      <text x="112" y="624" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#22252a">Spiral plate</text>
      <text x="112" y="643" font-size="11.5" fill="#71767e">spring edge seals to glass</text>
      <path d="M240 632 H282" stroke="#9aa0a8" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/><circle cx="286" cy="632" r="3.5" fill="#22252a"/>
    </g>
    <!-- 7 screw right -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="708" cy="690" r="13" fill="#22252a"/><text x="708" y="695" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#fff">7</text>
      <text x="728" y="686" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#22252a">Bottom screw</text>
      <text x="728" y="705" font-size="11.5" fill="#71767e">clamps plates 4–6 to the rod</text>
      <path d="M420 694 H700" stroke="#9aa0a8" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/><circle cx="416" cy="694" r="3.5" fill="#22252a"/>
    </g>
    <!-- 8 beaker left -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="92" cy="902" r="13" fill="#22252a"/><text x="92" y="907" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#fff">8</text>
      <text x="112" y="898" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#22252a">Glass beaker</text>
      <text x="112" y="917" font-size="11.5" fill="#71767e">borosilicate, spouted</text>
      <path d="M252 906 H272" stroke="#9aa0a8" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/><circle cx="276" cy="906" r="3.5" fill="#22252a"/>
      <path d="M218 910 L254 908" stroke="#9aa0a8" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    </g>
    <!-- 9 frame right -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="708" cy="1138" r="13" fill="#22252a"/><text x="708" y="1143" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#fff">9</text>
      <text x="728" y="1134" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#22252a">Frame & handle</text>
      <text x="728" y="1153" font-size="11.5" fill="#71767e">holder, base and handle</text>
      <path d="M545 1142 H700" stroke="#9aa0a8" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/><circle cx="541" cy="1142" r="3.5" fill="#22252a"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- fix left leader lines that were too short: overlay full lines -->
  <g stroke="#9aa0a8" stroke-width="1.2">
    <line x1="235" y1="476" x2="282" y2="476"/>
    <line x1="252" y1="554" x2="282" y2="554"/>
    <line x1="248" y1="632" x2="282" y2="632"/>
    <line x1="242" y1="906" x2="272" y2="906"/>
  </g>

  <!-- footer note -->
  <line x1="55" y1="1285" x2="1045" y2="1285" stroke="#c9c3b8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="55" y="1312" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#71767e">Assembly: stack 4 → 5 → 6 on the rod and tighten screw 7, slide the rod through the lid, fit the knob, then lower the plunger into the beaker seated in the frame.</text>
  <text x="55" y="1332" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#71767e">Dashed line = common centre axis.  Arrows show direction of assembly.</text>
</svg>
